title: POST JSON and Create Resources
summary: Read parsed JSON from request bodies, validate required fields, create resources, and return the created representation.

sketchBlocks.title: Write routes depend on JSON parsing before they read req.body

tryItExercises.title: Read a notice request body
tryItExercises.prompt: Register JSON parsing and implement `POST /api/notices/preview`. Return status `200` with `{ preview: req.body }`.
tryItExercises.hint: Make body parsing available before the route, then use the parsed request value.

help.concept: JSON middleware prepares structured request data for later write-route logic.
help.hint_1: Register the built-in parser on the application before the POST route.
help.hint_2: The route should return the parsed request value without creating a resource yet.

sketchBlocks.title: Validate before mutation, then return the created resource

tryItExercises.title: Create a club resource
tryItExercises.prompt: Implement `POST /api/clubs`. Require `name` and `focus`; return `400` JSON if either is missing. Otherwise create the next id, push the club, and return it with status `201`.

help.concept: A safe create route validates required input before it mutates shared state.
help.hint_1: Read the two allowed fields from the parsed request body.
help.hint_2: Only after validation should the route build and store a new object.

quizDraft.title: Find parsed request data
quizDraft.prompt: Where does Express expose a parsed JSON request body after `express.json()` runs?
quizDraft.hint: Choose the request property prepared by the JSON middleware.

help.concept: JSON middleware prepares one request property for structured body data.
help.hint_1: The application object registers middleware but does not hold the current request body.
help.hint_2: The response object sends data outward rather than storing incoming data.

quizDraft.title: Protect resource creation
quizDraft.prompt: Which two actions belong at the safe create boundary?
quizDraft.hint: Choose the actions that protect state and communicate creation deliberately.

help.concept: Create routes should reject unacceptable input before state changes and respond deliberately after creation.
help.hint_1: One correct choice protects the collection before it changes.
help.hint_2: Another communicates the new resource after it has been stored.

options: Return the created representation with the creation status.
Delete the collection before reading the body.
Treat missing fields as a server crash.

quizDraft.title: Complete the create response
quizDraft.prompt: Choose the status used when a new resource has been successfully created.
quizDraft.hint: Choose the success option that specifically communicates creation.

help.concept: HTTP has a dedicated success outcome for creating a new representation.
help.hint_1: The answer is not a client-error outcome.
help.hint_2: Prefer the option more specific than a normal read success.

quizDraft.template: A successful create route returns HTTP status [blank1] with the created representation.

quizDraft.title: Order a safe create route
quizDraft.prompt: Arrange the create flow from parsed input to response.
quizDraft.hint: The collection should not change until the input has been checked.

help.concept: A safe create route reads, validates, mutates, then responds.
help.hint_1: Start with the parsed incoming data.
help.hint_2: The response comes after valid data has been stored.
